parameters.query:
SELECT a.id, a.title, a.url, a.source, a.published_at, a.category, a.summary
FROM articles a
WHERE a.published_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day' * $2
AND ($1 = '' OR a.id IN (SELECT at.article_id FROM article_topics at INNER JOIN topics t ON t.id = at.topic_id WHERE t.slug = $1))
ORDER BY a.published_at DESC
